evidence: Quint. 1.5.42: in quibus nōs singulārem ac plūrālem habēmus
terms.comment: numerus plūrālis, the plural number; adverb plūrāliter, in the plural (Sen. NQ 2.56.1; Quint. 1.6.25). Traupman also gives multitūdō for “a plural”, from his pupil’s multitūdinem significāns, meaning a plural (248, 221).

phrases.english: we say tonitrua in the plural

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 221, p. 248.
